notes: Transcriber layout note: the table is printed as two parameter/value pairs side by side with a repeated 'Parameter / Values' header. The right-hand pair is a nested block whose own section labels are 'Influent' and 'Effluent' (rows with no value). Rows are kept as printed, left pair first.
Printed as 'T N - SS loading (kg/kg/day)' with a space inside 'T N'; retained.
The right-hand block leaves the second 'Values' cell empty on the Influent, Effluent, BOD - SS loading, T N - SS loading and Sludge aeration time rows. Retained as empty strings.
Values are printed with spaces around the hyphen (for example 13.5 - 16.0); the spacing is retained.

transcription.method: Direct viewing of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi page render and 300-360 dpi crops; no OCR, no paid service
transcription.observations: All ten printed rows read on both halves from a 300 dpi crop; the two-level right-hand block (Influent / Effluent headings) reconstructed from the printed rows only.

visual_recheck.method: distinct second visual inspection of exact source-region renders (incl. rotated/zoomed crops) by parent assistant; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Parent compared every cell, header and note against 144-dpi region renders (all five rotated T5.29 regions included).
